metadata.description: Morgan's Bluesky post queue - Educational and evergreen content

queue.text: What happens after we solve AI alignment? We're building a research simulation to explore pathways from super-alignment to sustainable flourishing. Every mechanic is grounded in peer-reviewed research (2024-2025).

The simulation runs 37 phases per step: from AI capability scaling to breakthrough tech deployment. Pure TypeScript engine with deterministic RNG for reproducible Monte Carlo analysis. Research tool, not a game.

Core principle: Research-backed realism over balance tuning. Never tune for 'fun' - only research-backed values. Every parameter needs 2+ peer-reviewed sources with justification. Let the model show what it shows.

AI capabilities are modeled across 17 dimensions: physical manipulation, digital ops, cognitive tasks, social influence, economic power, research breakthroughs. No single 'intelligence score' - different AIs excel in different domains.

Adversarial AI evaluation system: sandbagging (hiding capabilities), gaming benchmarks, sleeper agents. AIs can strategically misrepresent their abilities. Detection requires careful monitoring and diverse test suites.
Multi-Paradigm DUI: 4 simultaneous perspectives (Western Liberal, Development, Ecological, Indigenous). Quality of life measured differently in each paradigm. No single 'correct' view of progress.

71 breakthrough technologies across 5 tiers: TIER 0 (crisis response), TIER 1 (foundational), TIER 2 (transformative), TIER 3 (paradigm-shifting), TIER 4 (clarketech). Each grounded in current research trajectories.

Climate modeling based on IPCC 2024 reports and planetary boundaries framework. 9 interconnected systems: climate stability, biodiversity, ocean health, freshwater, land use. Tipping points can cascade.

AI alignment research draws from: Anthropic's Constitutional AI, DeepMind's alignment work, AI safety fundamentals. Models mesa-optimization, goal misgeneralization, reward hacking, deceptive alignment.
Recent milestone: 100% reproducibility across Monte Carlo runs. Deterministic simulation with seeded RNG. Every run with the same seed produces identical results. Critical for scientific validity.
Testing strategy: unit tests for phases, integration tests for system interactions, Monte Carlo validation (N≥10 runs), outcome distribution analysis. No silent fallbacks - fail loudly with context.

Quality of Life measured across 17 dimensions in 5 tiers: survival (basic needs), security (safety, healthcare), opportunity (education, mobility), fulfillment (culture, meaning), environment (air, water, ecosystems).

Development approach: multi-agent workflow with specialized experts. Research → validation → implementation → review → documentation. Every feature goes through quality gates. Maintain scientific rigor.

7-tier outcome classification: sustainable utopia, dynamic flourishing, managed stability, precarious balance, status quo drift, controlled decline, systemic collapse, existential catastrophe. Not binary.

Breakthrough tech research: fusion energy (ITER timelines), carbon capture (gigatonne-scale feasibility), asteroid mining (Planetary Resources studies), synthetic biology (CRISPR applications). All peer-reviewed.
Open source research simulation exploring post-alignment futures. 900+ line GameState interface, 40+ system modules, deterministic engine. Contributions welcome - we need more research validation.

Accumulation systems model long-term consequences: environmental debt (emissions, pollution), social debt (inequality, trust erosion), technological debt (infrastructure aging). Decisions have lasting effects.

Social modeling based on: political economy research, inequality studies (Piketty), institutional analysis (Acemoglu/Robinson), collective action problems (Ostrom). How societies respond to transformation.
Pictographic event language: Every emoji has ONE canonical meaning. 🌍 planetary, 🤖 AI, ☢️ nuclear, 💡 breakthrough, ❌ error. Registered in EMOJI_EVENT_MAP.txt. Pre-commit hooks enforce consistency.

Why build this? To understand: What challenges arise post-alignment? What tradeoffs exist between speed and stability? How do breakthroughs cascade? What failure modes should we watch for? Research, not prediction.
